summary: TTEC Holdings filed an 8-K reporting that on October 1, 2026 it, certain subsidiary guarantors, the lenders and Wells Fargo as administrative agent executed the Twelfth Amendment to its June 3, 2013 Amended and Restated Credit Agreement. The amendment cuts aggregate revolving commitments by $15 million to $960 million, caps aggregate revolving loans, swing loans and letters of credit at $950 million, extends the current 3.250% SOFR / 2.250% base-rate applicable margin through November 15, 2026, defers the step-up to 6.250% / 5.250% until November 16, 2026, and eliminates a 1.50% extension fee. TTEC paid lenders a $2.4 million upfront fee (0.25% of post-reduction commitments). This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch the November 16 margin step-up and any further covenant amendments.
